title: Meals at Home
text:
In my house, we eat breakfast at seven o'clock. I usually have bread, eggs, and a cup of milk. My brother likes cereal with fruit. We eat together at the table.

Lunch is at one o'clock at school. Today I ate rice, chicken, and a salad. For dinner, we eat soup and fish at home. I like dinner because we talk about our day.

questions.text: What does the writer usually have for breakfast?
What did the writer eat for lunch today?
Why does the writer like dinner?
options: Because the food is very expensive

questions.text: What can we guess about the writer's family?
options: They do not eat meals together

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
a food made from grain, often eaten with milk
a cold dish of mixed vegetables, often eaten with other food
a liquid food made by cooking vegetables, meat, or fish in water

paragraph_translations: En mi casa, desayunamos a las siete en punto. Normalmente tomo pan, huevos y un vaso de leche. A mi hermano le gusta el cereal con fruta. Comemos juntos en la mesa.
El almuerzo es a la una en la escuela. Hoy comí arroz, pollo y una ensalada. Para la cena, comemos sopa y pescado en casa. Me gusta la cena porque hablamos de nuestro día.
